15"""GCU400-specific ``_foreach_add_.List`` (in-place). 

16 

17The per-tensor flat kernel this file used to ship -- one launch per list 

18entry, sixteen ``@libentry`` dispatches per call -- measured a constant 

19~200us host tax on every shape and dtype, leaving the official benchmark 

20at 0.30-0.75x against ATen while every other ``.List`` member of the 

21family already ran on the single-launch paired-list kernel in 

22``_foreach_binary.py``. This file now delegates wholesale to that table 

23module, which keeps its own fallback chain: non-float / non-contiguous / 

24mixed dtypes / ragged sizes / ``alpha != 1`` all reach the common 

25executor with ATen's promotion and error wording. 

26 

27The import is relative on purpose. The same-named generic module 

28``flag_gems.ops._foreach_binary`` must not capture it: an absolute import 

29binds to the generic table and silently bypasses every GCU400 flat path 

30(stale-binding trap, same reasoning as the sign consolidation). 

31""" 

32 

33import logging 

34 

35from ._foreach_binary import _apply_list as _table_apply_list 

36 

37logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

38 

39 

40def _foreach_add__List(self, other, *, alpha=1): 

41 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME_GCU400 _FOREACH_ADD__LIST") 

42 # inplace wrappers answer None, matching the void result of 

43 # ``aten::_foreach_add_.List``. 

44 return _table_apply_list("add", self, other, True, alpha)
